game.name: Tank 1990 Remake
game.desc:
A remake of Battle City (Tank 1990): defend the eagle and destroy every enemy tank across 36 stages, alone or with up to four players on the same screen, each tank in its own color.
Extra modes: Duel, team against team (1 vs 1, 2 vs 2 or custom teams) on 10 symmetric maps; and Survival, 1 to 4 players against endless waves, with coins, a shop between waves and new powers such as mines, barricades, turrets, turbo and team shields. Gamepads for every player, with hotplug, and a match of a random mode playing behind the menu.
Remake by Gabryel Lima da Silva - Rio de Janeiro, Brazil - github.com/Gabryel-lima Based on Tanks by Krystian Kałużny (2015, MIT). Original game: Battle City, Namco 1985.
